scientific_integrity: Entire theorem has a self-contained mathematical proof with standard entropy and equidistribution inputs; finite diagnostics are supporting tests, not infinite certification. Bibliographic searches do not prove absolute uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: For Haar almost-everywhere one-sided generators of diagonal identity-times-integer-expansion toral maps; no pointwise, Markov, Rokhlin, arbitrary non-diagonal, or connectivity statement.
title: Dimension-independent optimal polyhedral generators for neutral toral products
